sg_hook: Watch the circle unroll into a wave.
sg_step_intro_caption: The circle on the left, an empty graph on the right.
sg_step_unroll_caption: The arc rolls out flat. Its length becomes x.
sg_step_sine_caption: The height of the point draws the wave sin θ.
sg_step_sine_predict_caption: Where does the sine wave reach its peak?
sg_step_sine_answer_caption: The peak is at π/2, where the point is highest.
sg_step_cosine_caption: Cosine is the same wave, shifted by π/2.
sg_step_periodic_caption: After one turn the wave starts over.
sg_step_explore_caption: Drag the point on the circle or on the curve.
